title: Could Louis read music?
summary: Scott says Armstrong could read a little, and Henderson's arrangements didn't require much.

story.theme_name: Working with and around Louis Armstrong
story.community_name: Playing with and around Louis Armstrong

blocks.x: He couldn't read then, could he?

Oh, yeah, he could -- well, he could read, but -- you know what I mean, Fletcher had arranged the music so that he wasn't obliged to read much. And mostly you relied on his trumpet solos. Louis could read, but he wasn't what you would call a topnotch reader. He could read a little, yeah. But what he had been playing mostly was just by ear. He could read a little.
Had you heard any recordings by him before then, before he came?
No, I had not heard any. In fact, I hadn't heard about Louis at all. But after he arrived here, then you began to hear everything, yes, indeed. Louis was a great guy.
